what_happened: Scene: layout/style 5 with black cabinets; the knife (knife_8, black handle) lies in a black drawer directly below the board (0.18 m), so the knife is very low-contrast; a large steak (steak_9) on a red plate right of the board. Stage 0: at 120-160 the knife was in the upper-left of the wrist view, but the gripper moved to the right side of the drawer (200-280, only black drawer interior visible), never got within 0.26 m of the knife and never closed near it. At ~320 it rose and went to the steak instead (stage 1's object), skipping stage 0. Stage-1 behaviour on the steak: close on air at 392, a touch without lift at 569, air close 607, look at the board 700-800, then a lifting grasp 885-908 (0.13 m). It carried the steak to the board and released at 954 with most of the steak over the board's near edge (0.15 m from the board centre); the steak tipped off the board and fell 0.17 m off the counter into the open drawer below (960-980). The arm followed it down, closed on air over the empty plate at 1259 and near the drawer at 1513, and the episode ended with the knife still in the drawer and the steak in the drawer.
causal_chain: black knife in a black drawer -> gripper went to the wrong side of the drawer 200-280 and never approached the knife -> switched to the steak at ~320 (stage 0 skipped) -> steak released half over the board's near edge 954 -> fell into the drawer -> nothing on the board; timeout
self_recovery: none for the knife (never attempted). For the steak: several air closes before a lifting grasp at 908; after the steak fell into the drawer, closes on air at 1259 and 1513.
official_criterion_notes: The knife moved 16 cm (x 2.620 -> 2.784) without any gripper touch, probably hit by the steak falling into the drawer at ~970. Its horizontal distance to the board is then only 0.08 m because the drawer is under the board; it is correctly not 'at target' (wrong height).
